Title: Promotion of the 2026 Multiple Major Essay Contest Programme
Posted: 14 October 2026

The Major Design Support Centre of the College of Liberal Studies is holding the "2026 Multiple Major Essay Contest – My Multiple Major Story, One Tale Leading to Another" [2026 다전공 수기 공모전 - 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기].

We welcome stories of the concerns, learning and growth you experienced while choosing and completing a multiple major. Interested students are encouraged to participate.

A. Contest overview

- Theme: Undergraduate students' experiences of completing a multiple major

- Eligibility: Current students in their third year or above (including students on leave of absence) and graduates who have had multiple-major experience during their undergraduate studies at the university
※ Multiple major [다전공]: double major [복수전공], minor [부전공], interdisciplinary major [연합전공], joint major [연계전공], student-designed major [학생설계전공]

- Submission deadline: Sunday, 22 November 2026

B. How to participate: Apply and submit your manuscript on SNU비교과 (SNU extracurricular programme system).

※ Direct link to the SNU비교과 post ▶ 2026 다전공 수기 공모전: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기 (the link address is not included in the text of the notice and was not read)

※ Search on SNU비교과 ▶ 2026 다전공 수기 공모전: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기
